## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
```

# Process Data
```{r}
sim_data_raw <- read.csv("../Data/data_4_1")
# data clearning
sim_data <- sim_data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    color = paste("#", color, sep = ""),
    passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption
  )

sim_data <- sim_data %>% filter(color != "#")
```

# Set Themes
```{r}
plot_theme <- theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'black'),
      panel.grid = element_line(colour = 'grey20'),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      title = element_text(size = 14, family = 'mono')
    )

plot_theme_light <- theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
      panel.grid = element_line(colour = 'grey90'),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = 'grey80'),
      title = element_text(size = 14, family = 'mono'),
    )
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = sim_data, aes(x = size)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlim(0, 15) +
  labs(title="Creature Size Throughout Simulation") +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Histogram_Creature_Size_Through_Simulation.png")
```

```{r}
population_size <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

producer_pop <- sim_data %>%
  filter(passiveEnergyChange < 0) %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

consumer_pop <- sim_data %>%
  filter(passiveEnergyChange >= 0) %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    summarise(count = n())

populations <- left_join(producer_pop, consumer_pop,  by="time") %>%
  rename(c(producer = count.x, consumer = count.y))

pops_long <- populations %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "role", values_to = "count")

ggplot(data = population_size, aes(time, count)) +
  geom_line() +
  # xlim(c(0,35000)) +
  labs(title = "Population Size over Time") +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Population_Through_Time")
  
ggplot(data = pops_long, aes(time, count, colour = role)) +
  geom_line() +
  # xlim(c(0,40000)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Population Size by Role over Time") +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Population_By_Role_Through_Time.png")
```
## animated graph of creatures size and speed over time with colors representing creature colors
```{r}
anim_length = 10
plot_data <- sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 500 == 0) %>%
  mutate(passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption) %>%
  select(time, speed, size, passiveEnergyChange, color)

nframes <- length(unique(plot_data$time))
fps <- round(nframes / anim_length)
p1 <- plot_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y =size, colour = color)) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    geom_point() +
    plot_theme + 
    labs(title = "Time: {round(frame_time, 0)}", x = 'speed', y = 'size') +
    transition_time(time) +
    ease_aes('linear')

animate(p1, width = 800, height = 800, nframes = nframes, fps = fps)
#anim_save('graph/Animation_Speed_Size');
```

```{r}
anim_length = 10
plot_data <- sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 500 == 0) %>%
  mutate(passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption,
         role = ifelse(passiveEnergyChange < 0, "consumer", "producer")) %>%
  select(time, speed, size, passiveEnergyChange, color, role)

nframes <- length(unique(plot_data$time))
fps <- round(nframes / anim_length)
p1 <- plot_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y =size, colour = role)) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    geom_point() +
    plot_theme + 
    labs(title = "Time: {round(frame_time, 0)}", x = 'speed', y = 'size') +
    transition_time(time) +
    ease_aes('linear')

animate(p1, width = 800, height = 800, nframes = nframes, fps = fps)
anim_save('graph/Animation_Speed_Size_by_Role');
```


```{r}
anim_length = 15
plot_data <- sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 100 == 0) %>%
  mutate(passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption) %>%
  select(time, speed, size, passiveEnergyChange, color)

nframes <- length(unique(plot_data$time))
fps <- round(nframes / anim_length)
p1 <- plot_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = size)) +
    geom_histogram() +
    scale_y_continuous(transform = scales::log_trans(base = 2)) +
    xlim(c(0, 30)) + 
    plot_theme_light + 
    labs(title = "Time: {round(frame_time, 0)}", x = 'size', y = 'frq') +
    transition_time(time) +
    ease_aes('linear')

animate(p1, width = 800, height = 800, nframes = nframes, fps = fps)
anim_save('graph/Animation_histogram_population_of_sizes_over_time');
```

```{r}
sim_data %>% 
  mutate(passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption) %>%
  filter(time > 10000) %>%
  select(time, speed, size, passiveEnergyChange, energyConsumption, autoGen, color) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y =size, colour = passiveEnergyChange)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = 'red',
      mid = 'white',
      high = 'green',
      midpoint = 0
    ) +
    plot_theme

#ggsave("graphs/plot_passive_energy_with_low_split_threshold.png")
```
```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 500 == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = size, z = detectRange)) +
  stat_summary_2d(
    aes(fill = after_stat(value)),
    fun = mean
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_b() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Detection Range Across Speed and Size",
    fill = "Mean Detect Range"
  ) +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Mean_Detection_Range_Across_Speed_and_Size.png")
```

```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 500 == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = size, z = splitThresh)) +
  stat_summary_2d(
    aes(fill = after_stat(value)),
    fun = mean
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_b() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Split Threshold Across Speed and Size",
    fill = "Mean SplitThresh"
  ) +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Mean_Split_Threshold_Across_Speed_and_Size.png")
```

```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 1000 == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = size, z = ifelse(passiveEnergyChange < 0, 1, 0))) +
  stat_summary_2d(
    aes(fill = after_stat(value)),
    fun = mean
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() + 
  labs(title = "Consumers Producer Curve") +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Consumer_Curve.png")
```

```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 100 == 0) %>%
  group_by(time, type =ifelse(passiveEnergyChange < 0, "consumer", 'producer')) %>%
  summarise(meanDetectRange = mean(detectRange)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = meanDetectRange, color = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Detection Range Over Time") +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Detection_Range_Over_Time.png")
```

```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 100 == 0 & time > 20000) %>%
  group_by(time, type =ifelse(passiveEnergyChange < 0, "consumer", 'producer')) %>%
  summarise(meanSplitThresh = mean(splitThresh)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = meanSplitThresh, color = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Split Threshold Over Time") +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Split_Threshold_Over_Time.png")
```

```{r}
# NPP per time
sim_data %>%
  filter(time > 100) %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(npp = sum(passiveEnergyChange)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(time, npp)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Net Primary Production Over Time")
  plot_theme_light
  
ggsave("graphs/NPP_Over_Time")
```

```{r}
sim_data %>%
  group_by(time, type =ifelse(passiveEnergyChange < 0, "heterotroph", 'autotroph')) %>%
  summarise(meanSpeed = mean(splitThresh)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = meanSpeed, color = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Speed Over Time") +
  plot_theme_light

ggsave("graphs/Speed_Over_Time.png")
```
